architecture_correction.previous_overbroad_claim: Official documentation does not establish a parent Agent invocation to child identifier bridge.
architecture_correction.corrected_claim: Current official documentation exposes a documented candidate bridge on Agent PostToolUse: tool_use_id identifies the parent Agent invocation and tool_response.agentId identifies the returned/launched subagent run. Subagent lifecycle exposes agent_id. Documentation capability evidence materially narrows the gap, but exact equality and event behavior on the installed target build remain runtime-unverified.
architecture_correction.promotion_rule: Promote candidate_join to VERIFIED_AT_EXACT_RUNTIME_IDENTITY only when the installed target build emits the fields and observed tool_response.agentId equals the lifecycle agent_id for the same child without timing/order inference.
architecture_correction.concurrency_rule: Two overlapping Agent calls remain separable by tool_use_id; never correlate children by session_id, timestamps, event order, agent_type, prompt similarity or task_id.
architecture_correction.task_namespace_rule: task_id remains optional and independent unless Task lifecycle actually participates.
architecture_correction.completion_rule: A child identifier or SubagentStop is execution evidence only; durable workpackage completion still requires bound reconcile/typed success evidence.
